name: Mermaid Mission: Titanic
source:
You're a new recruit in the mermaid army, working under Commander Flipsy, the dolphin. After a successful job in shark territory, you're given a top secret mission: become a human and learn the truth about the Titanic.

See, the humans are building a giant ship called the Titanic. It's the largest ship that has ever been built, which has the mermaids worried. Could it be the humans are planning to invade the mermaid kingdom? The ship launches later this week, so you don't have a lot of time to explore the human world and discover what's going on.

To make matters worse, there are three other mermaids who have been sent on this mission. All three of them disappeared, and no one has any idea what happened to them. Can you avoid their fate? Can you successfully pose as a human, without being discovered by your curious roommate Andreas or the foul villain Maynard? Will you help the mermaids destroy the Titanic, or will you choose to side with the humans?

With multiple endings, puzzles, colorful artwork and a script that's over 36,000 words, Mermaid Mission Titanic is a game that's sure to delight mermaid fans of all ages. This visual novel comes from the author of [url=/v19822]Cat President: A More Purrfect Union[/url] and [url=/v23144]The Pizza Delivery Boy Who Saved the World[/url].

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/849800/Mermaid_Mission_Titanic/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是美人鱼军队的新兵，在海豚弗利普希指挥官手下工作。在鲨鱼领地成功完成任务后，你接到一项绝密任务：变成人类，查明泰坦尼克号的真相。

人类正在建造一艘名为“泰坦尼克号”的巨轮。它是迄今建造过的最大船只，这让美人鱼们十分担忧。人类是不是打算入侵美人鱼王国？船将在本周晚些时候下水，所以你没有太多时间探索人类世界并查明发生了什么。

更糟的是，还有另外三名美人鱼被派来执行这项任务。她们三人全部失踪，没有人知道她们发生了什么。你能避开她们的命运吗？你能成功伪装成人类，不被好奇的室友安德烈亚斯或卑鄙的恶棍梅纳德发现吗？你会帮助美人鱼摧毁泰坦尼克号，还是选择站在人类一边？

多重结局、谜题、色彩缤纷的画面，以及超过36000字的剧本，《美人鱼任务：泰坦尼克号》一定能让各个年龄段的美人鱼爱好者感到愉快。本作作者还创作过[url=/v19822]《猫咪总统：更加毛茸茸的联盟》[/url]和[url=/v23144]《拯救世界的披萨外送员》[/url]。

（来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/849800/Mermaid_Mission_Titanic/]Steam[/url]）
